$comment: Render template. Copy to jobs/<slug>/template.json (or point config.render.template at your own) to change the look. Colours are #RRGGBB or #RRGGBBAA. No brand is baked in.

text.$engine: auto = ffmpeg drawtext + libass when your ffmpeg has them, otherwise the built-in pixel font. Force with "ffmpeg" or "pixel".

title.$show: hook = while the hook line is spoken; a number = that many seconds; "none" = no plate

watermark.$text: Optional. Your own handle or site, set by you. Empty = no watermark.

audio.$ducking: sidechain = music dips under the voice; static = music stays at musicGainDb; none = no music
